description: GLD965 15m; direct next MA5 at horizons 1..5 (15..75 minutes).
u=(future MA5-structural baseline)/current close; reconstructed prediction=B+close*u_hat.
future MA5 > current observed MA5; ties=0; probability threshold=0.5.
Current completed own bar is allowed. Saved reference return lags retain their original extra one-MTS-row delay. No raw price levels.
Four expanding folds, gap=30 context rows; common contiguous labels for all five horizons; no tuning, calibration or final holdout. 2026 was previously inspected.
Train-only null >=20% and zero variance removal; no VIF/Lasso gate. Fixed interpretable candidate groups, no outcome-selected features.
At least 4 features with >=5% of training total split gain, measured per fitted LightGBM. Diagnostic gate, not forced gain or proof of forecast skill.

Paired circular 30-row block bootstrap, 1000 samples within folds. Positive lower bound for MSE improvement (regression) or accuracy improvement (classification) vs structural baseline, plus gain gate. Exploratory, no multiplicity adjustment.
Ridge alpha=10, standardized X/Y; LogisticRegression C=0.1,max_iter=2000; no class weighting.
Daily macro excluded in this first experiment; no invented MTS volume or unverified fair-value unit conversions.
